quotes: Applications using legacy generated request or response messages now fail at the default gRPC serialization boundary: the new protobuf v2 interface requires ProtoReflect, which those messages do not implement.

A status detail encoded with a legacy generated message that is registered only in the old protobuf registry now produces an error from Details instead of the decoded message, because Any.UnmarshalNew resolves types from the protobuf v2 registry.

When an xDS server sends an invalid or missing load reporting interval, the client rejects the response and retries, but logs `invalid load_reporting_interval: <nil>` instead of the reason from duration validation.
The repository includes such generated messages, so RPCs that marshal or unmarshal them now fail at the default serialization boundary.
